---
# ── EAST AFRICA CV TEMPLATE (cv-typst) ────────────────────────────────────────
# Blank, fillable template built on the same cv-typst extension as template.qmd
# and template-south-sudan.qmd. Replace every [placeholder] with your details.
# A rendered worked example lives in _output/template-east-africa.pdf.

# ── IDENTITY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
name: Your Full Name
headline: Your Professional Title · Field · Area of Expertise
tagline: >-
  One-sentence positioning statement that appears under your headline —
  who you are, what you do, and the value you bring.

# ── CONTACT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
email: you@example.com
phone: "+211 9XX XXX XXX"
location: City, Country

# Optional online presence (add the lines you use)
# linkedin: linkedin.com/in/your-handle

# ── EAST AFRICA PERSONAL DETAILS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Standard on CVs across South Sudan, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and Ethiopia.
# Remove any field you prefer to omit; add dob / sex / marital-status as needed.
nationality: Your Nationality
region: State / Region of Origin
religion: Your Religion        # optional — include if relevant to the role

# ── FORMAT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
papersize: a4                  # A4 is standard across East Africa
resume-updated: Month Year
format:
  cv-typst: default
---

```{=typst}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  Section toggles — set to false to turn a section off entirely.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let include-publications = false

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  PROFESSIONAL PROFILE  (keep to 3–4 lines)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#summary-block[
  Briefly describe your professional identity, years of experience, and the
  #text(weight: "bold", fill: pystatr-blue)[sectors or domains] you work in.
  Mention one or two signature strengths and the kind of impact you create,
  then end with what you seek or can contribute to a
  #text(weight: "bold", fill: pystatr-gold)[mission-driven organization].
]

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  TWO-COLUMN BODY
//  Tip: for government / NGO / academic roles, move the Education section-title
//  block above Professional Experience.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#two-col(

  // ── MAIN COLUMN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  [

    #section-title[Professional Experience]

    #entry(
      "Job Title",
      "Organization / Employer",
      "City, Country",
      "Start — End",
      (
        [Lead with a strong action verb and focus on the outcome you delivered.],
        [Quantify where possible: managed #text(weight: "bold")[X staff], served #text(weight: "bold")[Y beneficiaries], covered #text(weight: "bold")[Z districts].],
        [Highlight a program, tool, or system you used, built, or improved.],
      )
    )

    #entry(
      "Earlier Job Title",
      "Organization / Employer",
      "City, Country",
      "Start — End",
      (
        [Describe what you did and the difference it made.],
        [Mention relevant projects, stakeholders, or geographic coverage.],
      )
    )

    #section-title[Education]

    #edu("Degree · Field of Study", "University or Institution", "City, Country", "Start — End")
    #edu("Diploma or Certificate", "Institution", "City, Country", "Year")

    // ── Research & Publications (shown only when toggle is true) ───────────────
    #if include-publications [
      #section-title[Research & Publications]

      #pub-entry(
        "Title of Paper, Report, or Article",
        "Lastname, F., Co-Author, A.",
        "Journal, Publisher, or Organization",
        "Year",
      )
    ]

    #section-title[Leadership & Community]

    #v(0.15em)
    #set list(indent: 0.6em, body-indent: 0.4em, marker: text(fill: pystatr-gold)[▸])
    - Leadership role or contribution — #text(weight: "bold")[Organization].
    - Volunteer, civic, or mentorship role and its impact.
    - Membership, representation, or recognition relevant to your field.
  ],

  // ── SIDEBAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  [

    #sidebar-title[Key Skills]

    #v(0.1em)
    #set list(indent: 0pt, body-indent: 0.35em, marker: text(fill: pystatr-gold)[▪])
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Skill area one]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Skill area two]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Skill area three]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Skill area four]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Skill area five]

    // ── Languages — a prominent section in East African CVs ───────────────────
    #sidebar-title[Languages]

    #v(0.1em)
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Language — Fluent (written & spoken)]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Mother tongue — Native]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Language — Conversational]

    #sidebar-title[Tools & Technology]

    #v(0.1em)
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Tool or software]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Tool or software]

    #sidebar-title[Interests]

    #v(0.1em)
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Interest one]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Interest two]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Interest three]

    // ── References — typically listed in full in East African CVs ─────────────
    #sidebar-title[References]

    #v(0.1em)
    #set text(size: 8.0pt, fill: pystatr-ink)
    #text(weight: "bold")[Referee Full Name] \
    #text(fill: pystatr-mute)[Title, Organization] \
    #text(fill: pystatr-mute)[Phone: +XXX XXX XXX XXX] \
    #text(fill: pystatr-mute)[Email: referee\@org.com]

    #v(0.35em)
    #text(weight: "bold")[Second Referee Name] \
    #text(fill: pystatr-mute)[Title, Organization] \
    #text(fill: pystatr-mute)[Phone: +XXX XXX XXX XXX] \
    #text(fill: pystatr-mute)[Email: referee2\@org.com]
  ],
)
```
